description: Reverse-ETL message activation: send a personalized push notification via the OneSignal REST API (`POST /notifications`, Subscription-ID targeting) to each row of an upstream DataFrame. Sends REAL push notifications the moment this asset materializes -- no upload-for-later-matching indirection.

inputs.description: pandas DataFrame from an upstream asset. Each row -> one OneSignal push send, personalized via message_template/heading_template.

outputs.description: Dagster asset materialization with metadata (messages_sent / messages_failed / rows_skipped_no_recipient). No downstream data -- the send side effect is a real push notification on the recipient's device.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Asset providing the DataFrame. Mutually exclusive with `source`.

source.label: Inline Source
source.description: Inline source config (sql / csv / inline). Mutually exclusive with `upstream_asset_key`.

recipient_column.label: Recipient Column
recipient_column.description: Upstream column holding the target OneSignal Subscription ID (current API field; replaces the deprecated Player ID).

message_template.label: Message Template
message_template.description: Push notification body ('contents') template. Supports {column_name} substitution from other upstream row columns.

heading_template.label: Heading Template
heading_template.description: Push notification title ('headings') template (same {column_name} substitution). Optional.

batch_size.label: Batch Size
batch_size.description: Max upstream rows per run (blast-radius safety cap, not a rate limit).

name: OneSignal Push Send
